title: outline.json of a Math Canvas bundle
description: A table of contents in reading order. Pages are zero-based and must lie inside the document; a child follows its parent and is one deeper (a reader clamps jumps). The entries that exercises refer to are the sections of the book: they have an id, and the ids are unique (which a schema cannot say; the tools check it).

id.description: Unique among the entries: the key by which a frame's section finds its entry.

label.description: The number printed with the heading, such as 1.1 or Chapter 3.

top.description: Where the heading starts on its page, measured from the top.
